test_kronos_predictor_regression: test the KronosPredictor regression against expected CSV output with configurable context length
test_kronos_predictor_mse: test the KronosPredictor MSE accuracy by sampling random time-series windows and comparing predictions
create_predictor_kronos: create a KronosPredictor with a loaded Kronos model and KronosTokenizer for time-series forecasting
run_predictor_predict: run predictor.predict with context features, timestamps, prediction length, and sampling parameters
load_kronos_model: load a pretrained Kronos model and KronosTokenizer from HuggingFace with a specific revision
